Class StudentEventService

java.lang.Object
york.studentevents.events.StudentEventService
public class StudentEventService extends Object
Application service exposing user-related business operations.

This service forms the Service layer of the stack, sitting between the controllers and repositories. Persistence is delegated to the injected repository; the service holds no state of its own.

    • registerForEvent

      public void registerForEvent(UUID userId, UUID eventId)
      Register a student for an event.
      Parameters:
      userId - the student's user ID
      eventId - the event's ID
      Throws:
      UserNotFoundException - if the user does not exist
      UserNotAuthorisedException - if the given user is not a Student
      EventNotFoundException - if the event does not exist
      IllegalArgumentException - if the student is already registered for the event
      CapacityExceededException - if the event is full

      public void subscribeToEvent(UUID userId, UUID eventId)
      Subscribe a Student to receive an Event's notifications without registering them to attend.
